title_en: Humble’s Isometric Immersion CRPG Pack Features 11 Games With a $291 Value That You Can Add to Your PC Library for As Low as $23
summary_en: Humble’s Isometric Immersion CRPG Pack includes 11 games that have a total value of $291, but you can grab them all for your PC library for as low as $23.
body_en:
If your Steam library is in need of some new PC games to play this fall, Humble's impressive Isometric Immersion CRPG Pack is worth checking out. In total, it comes with 11 games - including big hits like Disco Elysium: The Final Cut and Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - that have a total cost of $291, but you can snag them all for as low as $23.
That's an incredible offer to be able to add all of these games - which you can see fully listed out below - to your Steam library. The bundle won't be available for long, though. Humble's store page states that it comes to an end in 7 days, so you only have a week left to add these new adventures to your PC library.
As with many other bundles from Humble, you can actually choose how much you'd like to spend on it, though there are some changes that come into play. If you pay $15 instead, you'll get 9 games from the bundle rather than the full 11, which are: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous, SKALD: Against the Black Priory, Black Geyser: Couriers of Darkness, Black Geyser: Couriers of Darkness - Tales of the Moon Cult, Torment: Tides of Numenera, Gamedec, Disco Elysium, UnderRail, and Balrum.
If you decide to drop even lower to $10, then you'll get five games: Torment: Tides of Numenera, Gamedec, Disco Elysium, UnderRail, and Balrum. So, if you're hoping to get all 11, $23 is as low as you can go. On the other hand, if you're feeling generous, you can opt to pay a little extra as well, which gets you all 11 games and gives more to publishers, Humble, and charity. The latter for this bundle is Little Free Library .
Quite a few of the games here have earned high marks from us as well, so it's exciting to see them all in one big bundle. Disco Elysium: The Final Cut was a solid 10/10 in our review , while both Rogue Trader and Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous earned 8s in their respective reviews. Torment: Tides of Numenera even inched above those with a score of 8.8, so there's plenty of great options to keep you entertained.
Again, though, this bundle only has 7 days left before it comes to an end. Be quick to grab it before it's all gone.
Hannah Hoolihan is a freelancer who writes with the guides and commerce teams here at IGN.
